original: Given the `validate` closure in `src/execution/lifecycle/acceptance-loop.ts`, when called with either mode, then behavior remains unchanged and mode is ignored.
refined: The `validate` closure assigned in `src/execution/lifecycle/acceptance-loop.ts` accepts the `opts` parameter. Unit tests confirm that calling with `{ mode: "full" }` and `{ mode: "lite" }` produce identical behavior to the baseline (mode argument is not used in the closure body).

original: Given `makeCycle` in `test/unit/findings/cycle.test.ts`, when declaring `validateFn`, then the parameter type is `(ctx: FixCycleContext, opts: { mode: "full" | "lite" }) => Promise<Finding[]>`.
refined: The `makeCycle` test helper function in `test/unit/findings/cycle.test.ts` has `validateFn` parameter with type `(ctx: FixCycleContext, opts: { mode: "full" | "lite" }) => Promise<Finding[]>`. TypeScript strict mode compilation of test files succeeds.

original: Given non-terminal validation where `cycle.validate` throws, when `runFixCycle` executes, then existing validator-retry/validator-error behavior is unchanged except that the call shape includes `{ mode: "full" }`.
refined: When `cycle.validate` throws an error during non-terminal validation in `runFixCycle`, the error is caught and handled using the existing retry/error recovery logic. Unit test asserts that the error handler receives an error with identical properties to the baseline test, and audit trail shows the call was made with `{ mode: "full" }`.

original: When all active strategies have reached `maxAttempts` after an iteration's `fixesApplied`, then `runFixCycle` invokes `cycle.validate(ctx, { mode: "lite" })` exactly once.
refined: When all active strategies exhaust maxAttempts after an iteration, cycle.validate(ctx, { mode: "lite" }) is called exactly once

original: When lite validate returns an empty array in the terminal exhausted branch, then `runFixCycle` returns `exitReason: "resolved"`, `finalFindings: []`, and `exhaustedStrategy: undefined`.
refined: When cycle.validate returns [], runFixCycle return value satisfies { exitReason: "resolved", finalFindings: [], exhaustedStrategy: undefined }

original: When lite validate returns non-empty findings in the terminal exhausted branch, then `runFixCycle` returns `exitReason: "max-attempts-per-strategy"`, `finalFindings` equal to the lite result, and `exhaustedStrategy` equal to the first strategy name in the execution group.
refined: When cycle.validate returns non-empty array, runFixCycle return value satisfies { exitReason: "max-attempts-per-strategy", finalFindings: deepEqual(liteResult), exhaustedStrategy: firstStrategyName }

original: Given terminal exhausted processing with successful lite validate, when the iteration is pushed, then `findingsAfter` equals the lite validate return value rather than the pre-fix `cycle.findings` snapshot.
refined: When terminal exhausted processing succeeds, pushed iteration.findingsAfter equals lite validate return value (not pre-fix cycle.findings)

original: Given terminal exhausted processing with successful lite validate, when outcome is set, then it equals `classifyOutcome(findingsBefore, liteFindingsAfter)`.
refined: When terminal exhausted processing succeeds, iteration.outcome deepEqual classifyOutcome(findingsBefore, liteFindingsAfter)

original: Given terminal exhausted processing with successful lite validate, when exit is prepared, then `cycle.findings` is updated to the lite validate return value.
refined: When terminal exhausted processing succeeds, cycle.findings is mutated to equal lite validate return value before exit

original: When the terminal lite validate call throws, then `runFixCycle` returns `exitReason: "max-attempts-per-strategy"` with `finalFindings` equal to existing `cycle.findings`, keeps `exhaustedStrategy` set to the first strategy in group, and does not consume validator-retry budget.
refined: When cycle.validate throws, runFixCycle returns { exitReason: "max-attempts-per-strategy", finalFindings: deepEqual(preThrowCycleFindings), exhaustedStrategy: firstStrategyName }, and validatorRetryBudget unchanged

original: When terminal lite validate throws, then `runFixCycle` emits a warn log containing stage `findings.cycle` and data fields `storyId`, `packageDir`, `cycleName`, and `error`.
refined: When cycle.validate throws, logger.warn called with stage="findings.cycle" and context object containing storyId, packageDir, cycleName, error keys

original: When terminal exhausted branch resolves after successful lite validate with empty findings, then `runFixCycle` emits an info log with stage `findings.cycle` whose data object has first key `storyId` and includes `packageDir`, `cycleName`, and `reason: "resolved"`.
refined: When terminal branch resolves with empty findings, logger.info called with stage="findings.cycle" and context { storyId, packageDir, cycleName, reason: "resolved", ... } with storyId as first key

original: When terminal exhausted branch exits cap-exhausted after successful lite validate with non-empty findings, then `runFixCycle` emits an info log with stage `findings.cycle` whose data object has first key `storyId` and includes `packageDir`, `cycleName`, `reason: "max-attempts-per-strategy"`, `exhaustedStrategy`, and `liteFindingsAfter`.
refined: When terminal branch exits with non-empty findings, logger.info called with stage="findings.cycle" and context { storyId, packageDir, cycleName, reason: "max-attempts-per-strategy", exhaustedStrategy, liteFindingsAfter, ... } with storyId as first key

original: Given a terminal attempt where a strategy `extractApplied` returns `unresolved`, when `runFixCycle` processes that iteration, then it exits `agent-gave-up` without invoking `cycle.validate`.
refined: When terminal attempt has unresolved strategy from extractApplied, runFixCycle returns { exitReason: "agent-gave-up", ... } and cycle.validate is never called

original: Given `PipelineContext`, when `skipLLMReviewers` is unset, then behavior is identical to `false`.
refined: When `ctx.skipLLMReviewers` is undefined, all downstream logic behaves identically to when `ctx.skipLLMReviewers === false`

original: Given `recheckReview`, when called as `recheckReview(ctx)` or `recheckReview(ctx, {})`, then it returns the same pass/fail result as current behavior for the same `ctx.reviewResult` inputs.
refined: `recheckReview(ctx)` and `recheckReview(ctx, {})` return identical boolean values for identical input contexts

original: Given `recheckReview(ctx, { lite: true })`, when delegating to review stage, then it augments `ctx.retrySkipChecks` with `"adversarial"` and `"semantic"` only for that call and restores the original value afterward, including when original was `undefined` and when delegated call throws.
refined: When `recheckReview(ctx, { lite: true })` delegates to review stage: (a) `ctx.retrySkipChecks` is mutated to include both `"adversarial"` and `"semantic"` before delegation; (b) original array/undefined is restored after delegation completes or throws; (c) restoration occurs in a finally block ensuring it executes even on error

original: Given `recheckReview(ctx, { lite: true })`, when delegating to review stage, then it sets `ctx.skipLLMReviewers = true` only for that call and restores the original value afterward, including when original was `undefined` and when delegated call throws.
refined: When `recheckReview(ctx, { lite: true })` delegates to review stage: (a) `ctx.skipLLMReviewers` is set to `true` before delegation; (b) original value (including undefined) is restored after delegation completes or throws; (c) restoration occurs in a finally block ensuring it executes even on error

original: Given `recheckReview(ctx, { lite: true })`, when `ctx.reviewResult.success === true`, then it returns `true` regardless of `failOpen` checks.
refined: `recheckReview(ctx, { lite: true })` returns `true` when `ctx.reviewResult.success === true`, even if `ctx.reviewResult.checks` contains one or more failing checks with `failOpen: true`

original: Given `recheckReview(ctx)` or `recheckReview(ctx, { lite: false })`, when `ctx.reviewResult.checks` includes a `failOpen` check, then it returns `false` and does not mutate `retrySkipChecks` or `skipLLMReviewers`.
refined: When `ctx.reviewResult.checks` contains a failing check with `failOpen: true`: (a) `recheckReview(ctx)` returns `false`; (b) `recheckReview(ctx, { lite: false })` returns `false`; (c) `ctx.retrySkipChecks` is not modified; (d) `ctx.skipLLMReviewers` is not modified

original: Given `_autofixDeps.runReviewStage`, when invoked, then it wraps dynamic `import("./review")` and calls `reviewStage.execute(ctx)` using signature `(ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<void>`.
refined: `_autofixDeps.runReviewStage` is an async function with exact signature `(ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<void>` that dynamically imports the review stage module and invokes `reviewStage.execute(ctx)` passing the context

original: Given `_autofixDeps.runReviewStage`, when `reviewStage.enabled(ctx) === false`, then it returns without invoking `reviewStage.execute`.
refined: When `reviewStage.enabled(ctx)` returns `false`, `_autofixDeps.runReviewStage(ctx)` returns successfully without calling `reviewStage.execute`

original: Given `reviewStage.execute` and `ctx.skipLLMReviewers === true`, when dialogue retry branch conditions are otherwise met, then `ctx.reviewerSession.reReview()` is not invoked.
refined: When `ctx.skipLLMReviewers === true` and all dialogue retry branch conditions are met, `ctx.reviewerSession.reReview()` is not called

original: Given `reviewStage.execute` and `ctx.skipLLMReviewers === true`, when dialogue first-run branch conditions are otherwise met, then `ctx.reviewerSession.review()` is not invoked.
refined: When `ctx.skipLLMReviewers === true` and all dialogue first-run branch conditions are met, `ctx.reviewerSession.review()` is not called

original: Given `reviewStage.execute` and `ctx.skipLLMReviewers` unset or false, when dialogue conditions are met, then dialogue branches execute as before with no behavior change.
refined: When `ctx.skipLLMReviewers` is `undefined` or `false`, dialogue branches execute with identical behavior to before this feature (review() and reReview() called when branch conditions are met)

original: Given `reviewDebateEnabled === true`, when executing review stage with lite recheck signals, then control reaches orchestrator path where runner honors `ctx.retrySkipChecks` and no additional debate-branch `skipLLMReviewers` check is required.
refined: When `reviewDebateEnabled === true` and lite recheck mode is active (`ctx.retrySkipChecks` includes adversarial/semantic), the review stage executes the orchestrator path and `ctx.retrySkipChecks` is honored by runner routing logic

original: Given `recheckReview(ctx, { lite: true })`, when `_autofixDeps.runReviewStage` throws, then the throw is propagated after `ctx.retrySkipChecks` and `ctx.skipLLMReviewers` are restored to their original values.
refined: When `_autofixDeps.runReviewStage` throws an error during `recheckReview(ctx, { lite: true })`: (a) `ctx.retrySkipChecks` is restored to its original value before throw propagates; (b) `ctx.skipLLMReviewers` is restored to its original value before throw propagates; (c) the error is re-thrown unchanged

original: Given the `validate` closure in `src/pipeline/stages/autofix-cycle.ts`, when called, then it invokes `_autofixDeps.recheckReview(ctx, { lite: opts.mode === "lite" })` on every call.
refined: The validate closure must invoke _autofixDeps.recheckReview(ctx, { lite: <boolean> }) where the lite property equals true when opts.mode === "lite" and false when opts.mode === "full"

original: When `runFixCycle` invokes the closure with `opts.mode === "full"`, then LLM reviewers configured in `config.checks` execute as in current non-terminal behavior.
refined: When opts.mode === "full", the recheckReview call must receive { lite: false } as the second argument, enabling normal (non-lite-mode) LLM review execution

original: When `runFixCycle` invokes the closure with `opts.mode === "full"`, then `_autofixDeps.recheckReview` receives `{ lite: false }` and does not run lite-mode LLM-skip behavior.
refined: recheckReview must be called with second argument { lite: false } when opts.mode === "full", preventing lite-mode behavior

original: When `runFixCycle` invokes the closure with `opts.mode === "lite"`, then no `adversarial` or `semantic` LLM call is dispatched, including dialogue path when `config.review.dialogue.enabled === true`.
refined: When opts.mode === "lite", recheckReview must receive { lite: true }, which must suppress adversarial and semantic LLM dispatcher calls and dialogue-path LLM invocations

original: Given the same closure execution, when mode forwarding is added, then existing behavior for `iterationBeforeRef` capture, `collectCurrentFindings`, `resolveTestFilePatterns`, `validateMockStructureFiles`, `pendingMockStructureHandoffs` stash, `applyTestEditDeclarations`, and `ctx.testEditDeclarations` clearing remains unchanged.
refined: All closure body operations (iterationBeforeRef capture, collectCurrentFindings, resolveTestFilePatterns, validateMockStructureFiles, pendingMockStructureHandoffs stash, applyTestEditDeclarations, ctx.testEditDeclarations clearing) must execute in their current sequence and order relative to the recheckReview invocation
